therapeuticClass: Cardiovascular — Direct Oral Anticoagulant (DOAC) — Factor Xa Inhibitor
indication: Reduction of stroke and systemic embolism risk in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation; DVT and PE treatment and secondary prevention; DVT prophylaxis post-elective hip/knee replacement surgery
quantityLimitReason: Dosing regimen is 5 mg twice daily (standard) or 2.5 mg twice daily (dose-reduction criteria). Quantity limit aligns with standard dose.
formularyNotes: Eliquis (apixaban) and Xarelto (rivaroxaban) are both Tier 3. Warfarin remains Tier 1 but requires INR monitoring. Pradaxa (dabigatran) is Tier 3. No step therapy required for DOACs. Coverage note: Eliquis at 2.5 mg dose (post-surgical VTE prophylaxis) requires dose documentation to prevent quantity limit claim edits.
clinicalAlerts: No reversal agent widely available in all settings — andexanet alfa (Andexxa) available at selected facilities
Dose reduction criteria: age ≥ 80 OR weight ≤ 60 kg OR SCr ≥ 1.5 mg/dL (at least 2 of 3 criteria met)
Avoid in severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C)
